title: Beta closed Oct 23; launch Nov 4, 3 p.m. PST (23:00 UTC); character creation Oct 27
claim: The beta closed Oct 23 after five weeks; character creation and name reservation open Tue Oct 27 (EU 18:00 CET, NA 1 p.m. PDT); WoW Forever launches globally Nov 4, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. PST (23:00 UTC, 00:00 CET Nov 5); raids unlock Dec 9.
detail: Launch time now read in Blizzard's own announcement (24302093), which says 3:00 p.m. PST in the body and '3:00 p.m. PDT' in the intro; DST ends Nov 1, so PST (UTC-8) is meant, matching the French article's 'minuit (heure de Paris)'. One global moment, no regional staggering. Beta characters and progress do not carry over. Kaivax: a few days of priority fixes before launch. Name reservation details: n:20261010-name-reservation-oct27.

title: Hunter: melee resetting Auto Shot is a known bug (designer), still live at beta end
claim: Melee swings reset the Hunter Auto Shot timer even when the shot is ready; designer Aidan Moon called this a bug for Hunters (#14, Oct 6; not a bug for Warrior Throw), it was still present on the Oct 16 build, and #387 was closed as a duplicate/feedback on Oct 21; no fix date announced.
detail: On top of the intended 0.5 s stand-still (n:20261017-wand-autoshot-stand-still). Until fixed, melee-weaving costs ranged shots: while leveling, don't swing in melee between Auto Shots unless the mob is about to die. For Warriors, Throw and melee sharing a cooldown is intended (Aidan Moon). Forum: 'Hunters afk for 80% of their rotation' (118 posts).

title: Build 70532: client files unchanged; changes came only as server hotfixes
claim: forever-ref's 70532 snapshot (Oct 23) has 0 added, removed or changed rows versus 70450 across 31,949 spells, 19,257 items and 2,649 recipes, matching Daybreak's table diff; class changes seen on 70532 (n:20261024-hotfix-champion-of-the-light, n:20261024-frost-blast-coefficient-cut) are server hotfixes.
detail: Hotfix data appears in a client's cache, not in the build files, so file diffs miss it. ForeverDB (local client cache, Oct 24) and ForeverChanges/WoWForeverTalents (public hotfix listing) report them. 70532 was the last beta build; the live client may differ.

title: Paladin: Champion of the Light back to 20/40/60% of Intellect (hotfix, unconfirmed)
claim: Hotfix trackers report that Retribution's Champion of the Light (1311084) gives spell damage equal to 20/40/60% of Intellect per rank again, after Blizzard's Oct 15 notes cut it to 10/20/30%.
detail: ForeverDB's 70532 changelog (local client cache) and ForeverChanges/wowclassicforever.info show 20/40/60%; Kami Labs notes all read the same hotfix listing, so it's not independent, and SeeMeta still shows the 10/20/30% cut. Blizzard's Paladin deep dive says 'up to 30%'. Verify in game at launch. Matters for Ret Seal of Righteousness/Consecration damage while leveling.

title: Mage: Frost Blast spell power coefficient 0.343 -> 0.271; Winter's Chill reworked
claim: ForeverDB's 70532 changelog shows Frost Blast (1326055, ranks 1-3) spell power coefficient cut from 0.343 to 0.271, and Winter's Chill now applied only by Frostbolt, Frost Blast and Fingers of Frost Ice Lance, giving Cone of Cold +5% damage plus 7% of spell damage per stack (was 40%).
detail: Frost Blast is the new level-24 AoE slow (n:20261017-mage-frost-blast-24), central to Frost Mage AoE leveling; the cut is about 21% of its spell-power scaling. Also: Arcane Wrath (108-132 + 5% max mana) moved from class ability to talent; Frostbite and Permafrost swap places; Missile Barrage can proc from Frost Blast. Server hotfix data from the client cache; single source.

title: Paladin: Righteous Fury learned at level 10 (was 16), hotfix
claim: ForeverChanges lists an unannounced Oct 23 hotfix: Paladins learn Righteous Fury at level 10 instead of 16.
detail: Relevant for Protection/AoE-tank leveling and dungeon tanking from the early dungeons (RFC, Deadmines). Single tracker; not in Blizzard notes.

title: Shaman: Lava Burst rank 3 bonus vs Flame Shock cut 54% -> 20%
claim: Hotfix trackers report that Lava Burst rank 3's bonus damage against Flame Shocked targets is 20% (was 54%), matching the other ranks.
detail: Lava Burst is a talent from 30 (n:20261017-shaman-oct15). ForeverChanges and WoWForeverTalents (70532 hotfix list); both read the same hotfix data.

title: Levels 30-60 were never tested publicly; quick post-launch fixes planned
claim: On podcast episode 5 (Oct 22), Blizzard said the beta only went to level 30 with 4 of 9 new dungeons; levels 30-60, the other dungeons and raids were tested internally only, and the team plans quick fixes after launch.
detail: Expect early hotfixes to 30-60 quests, XP, respawns and mob levels. Glide's 30-60 data (seed, routes) comes from files and community projects, not play; weight live observations above 30 higher than the seed until the first weeks settle. Aggrend ~8:45 per ForeverDB; Kami Labs summary adds the post-launch fixes plan.

title: Blizzard plans to revise campfire damage after it killed low-level players
claim: On podcast episode 5, Blizzard said campfires in starting zones killed low-level players and that it will revise their damage while keeping the mechanic.
detail: Current rule: no damage below level 5, reduced damage below 90% health (n:20261008-campfire-rules). No numbers or date given. Relayed by Kami Labs' summary only; check the episode before treating as official.

title: Creature aggro radius was too small in beta week 1, corrected in week 2
claim: Blizzard said on podcast episode 5 that creature aggro radius was too small in the first beta week and was corrected in week two.
detail: So pull spacing from week-1 beta reports or videos (before ~Sept 24) understates how far mobs aggro. No numbers given. Relayed by Kami Labs' summary only.

title: Hunter pets gain 0 HP from extra pet Stamina (bug report)
claim: A bug report with video shows Hunter pets gaining no health from Great Stamina (Beast Training) or set-bonus Stamina; expected +10 HP per point.
detail: If not fixed at launch, don't spend training points on Great Stamina while leveling; pet survivability comes only from base and your own stats. Pending approval, no staff reply yet. Related: #433 Pet Defensive stance not working as intended.
